auth.description:
To create your Apollo API key:

1. Go to **Settings** > **[Integrations](https://app.apollo.io/#/settings/integrations)** in Apollo
2. Click **Connect** beside Apollo API
3. Click **API Keys** > **Create new key**
4. Enter a name and description, then select the endpoints you need (or toggle **Set as master key** for full access)
5. Click **Create API key** and copy it to a secure location

**Note:** Some endpoints require a master API key. Keep your API keys secure and be careful with whom you share access.

[Learn more about creating API keys](https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key)

matchPerson.name: matchPerson
matchPerson.description: Enrich a persons details using their email address

email.description: The email address of the person to be matched

cacheResponse.description: Store the response in the project store for future use.

aiMetadata.description: Look up and enrich a single person in the Apollo database by their email address, returning their profile data. Use when you have an email and need the matching contact/profile details. Read-only and idempotent; an optional project-store cache may return a previously fetched result for the same email.

cacheResponse.description: Store the response in the project store for future use.

aiMetadata.description: Look up and enrich a single company in the Apollo database by its web domain, returning the organization profile. Use when you have a company domain and need firmographic details. Read-only and idempotent; an optional project-store cache may return a previously fetched result for the same domain.

newsArticlesSearch.name: newsArticlesSearch
newsArticlesSearch.description: Search for news articles related to companies in the Apollo database

organization_ids.description: The Apollo IDs for the companies you want to include in your search results. To find IDs, call the Organization Search endpoint.

categories.description: Filter your search to include only certain categories or sub-categories of news (e.g., hires, investment, contract)

published_at_min.description: Lower bound of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD format)

published_at_max.description: Upper bound of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD format)

cacheResponse.description: Store the response in the project store for future use.

aiMetadata.description: Search the Apollo database for news articles about specific companies, filterable by news category and a published-date range. Use to surface recent events (hires, funding, contracts) for given organizations. Requires Apollo organization IDs (obtained from Organization Search). Read-only and idempotent.

organizationJobPostings.name: organizationJobPostings
organizationJobPostings.description: Retrieve current job postings for a company to identify growing headcount areas

organization_id.description: The Apollo ID of the organization to get job postings for

cacheResponse.description: Store the response in the project store for future use.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the current job postings for a single company in the Apollo database, useful for spotting hiring activity and growth areas. Requires the Apollo organization ID (obtained from Organization Search). Read-only and idempotent.

organizationSearch.name: organizationSearch
organizationSearch.description: Search for companies in the Apollo database with various filters

cacheResponse.description: Store the response in the project store for future use.

aiMetadata.description: Search the Apollo database for companies using filters such as name, location, employee-count range, domain, and industry tags. Use to discover organizations or to resolve a company to its Apollo organization ID for downstream actions. Read-only and idempotent.

peopleSearch.name: peopleSearch
peopleSearch.description: Search for people in the Apollo database (does not return email/phone, use enrichment for that)

organization_num_employees_ranges.description: Filter by organization employee count ranges (e.g., "1,10", "250,500")

cacheResponse.description: Store the response in the project store for future use.

aiMetadata.description: Search the Apollo database for people using filters such as keywords, job titles, seniority, location, and their organization (domain, location, employee-count range). Use to find prospects matching criteria; note the results do not include email or phone, so use Match Person enrichment for contact details. Read-only and idempotent.

de.\nTo create your Apollo API key:\n\n1. G:

Para criar sua chave de API Apollo:
. Vá para **Configurações** > **[Integrations](https://app.apollo.io/#/settings/integrations)** no Apollo

3. Clique em **Chaves de API** > **Crie nova chave**
4. Digite um nome e descrição, então selecione os pontos de extremidade que você precisa (ou defina como chave mestra** para acesso completo)
5. Clique em **Criar chave de API** e copiá-lo para um local seguro

**Nota:** Alguns endpoints requerem uma chave de API mestra. Mantenha suas chaves de API seguras e tenha cuidado com quem compartilhar o acesso.
